# Code Block Fixture

Exercises Shiki highlighting and half-width code blocks.

## Python

```python
def hello(name: str) -> str:
    """Greet someone."""
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(hello("world"))
```
